activemq_otel-blocked-sends-detected.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] Blocked sends detected
activemq_otel-blocked-sends-detected.esql:
TS metrics-activemq.otel-*
// activemq.queue.blocked.sends is counter_long; dimension: activemq.destination.name
| WHERE activemq.queue.blocked.sends IS NOT NULL
| STATS blocked_rate = SUM(RATE(activemq.queue.blocked.sends)) BY activemq.broker.name, activemq.destination.name
// Any blocked sends indicate memory pressure — critical signal
| WHERE blocked_rate > 0
| SORT blocked_rate DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-broker-memory-utilization-.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] Broker memory utilization high
activemq_otel-broker-memory-utilization-.esql:
TS metrics-activemq.otel-*
// Broker memory utilization is a gauge (0–1 ratio)
| WHERE activemq.memory.utilization IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_util = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(activemq.memory.utilization)) BY activemq.broker.name, host.name
// Alert when memory utilization exceeds 85%; producers may be blocked
| WHERE max_util > 0.85
| SORT max_util DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-dlq-depth-high.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] Dead letter queue depth high
activemq_otel-dlq-depth-high.esql:
TS metrics-activemq.otel-*
// activemq.message.current is gauge; destination name in activemq.destination.name
| WHERE activemq.message.current IS NOT NULL AND activemq.destination.name == "ActiveMQ.DLQ"
| STATS dlq_depth = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(activemq.message.current)) BY activemq.broker.name, activemq.destination.name
// Alert when DLQ accumulates significant messages; adjust threshold for your tolerance
| WHERE dlq_depth > 100
| SORT dlq_depth DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-high-jvm-cpu.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] High JVM CPU utilization
activemq_otel-high-jvm-cpu.esql:

| WHERE activemq.jvm.cpu.process.usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS avg_cpu = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(activemq.jvm.cpu.process.usage)) BY activemq.broker.name, host.name
// Alert when CPU exceeds 85%; adjust for your baseline
| WHERE avg_cpu > 0.85
| SORT avg_cpu DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-high-jvm-heap-utilization.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] High JVM heap utilization
activemq_otel-high-jvm-heap-utilization.esql:
TS metrics-activemq.otel-*
// JVM heap metrics are broker-level (no destination dimension)
| WHERE activemq.jvm.memory.heap.used IS NOT NULL AND activemq.jvm.memory.heap.max IS NOT NULL AND activemq.jvm.memory.heap.max > 0
| STATS heap_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(activemq.jvm.memory.heap.used)), heap_max = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(activemq.jvm.memory.heap.max)) BY activemq.broker.name, host.name
| EVAL heap_util = heap_used / heap_max
// Alert when heap utilization exceeds 85%; adjust threshold for your environment
| WHERE heap_util > 0.85
| SORT heap_util DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-queue-depth-high.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] Queue depth high
activemq_otel-queue-depth-high.esql:
TS metrics-activemq.otel-*
// activemq.message.current is gauge; exclude advisory/system destinations
| WHERE activemq.message.current IS NOT NULL
  AND activemq.destination.name IS NOT NULL
  AND activemq.destination.name NOT IN ("ActiveMQ.DLQ", "ActiveMQ.Advisory.MasterBroker", "ActiveMQ.Advisory.Queue", "ActiveMQ.Advisory.Topic")
| STATS queue_depth = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(activemq.message.current)) BY activemq.broker.name, activemq.destination.name
// Alert when queue depth exceeds 1000; adjust for your expected throughput
| WHERE queue_depth > 1000
| SORT queue_depth DESC
| LIMIT 10

activemq_otel-store-utilization-high.name: [ActiveMQ OTel] Persistent store utilization high

apache_otel-saturation-high-busy-workers.name: [Apache OTel] High busy workers ratio
apache_otel-saturation-high-busy-workers.esql:
// Alert triggers when the ratio of busy workers to total workers exceeds the threshold.
// High busy worker ratio indicates the server is near capacity and may start rejecting connections.
// The alert is grouped by host name.
// You can adjust the threshold value by modifying the busy_ratio in the WHERE clause (default: > 0.85 = 85%).
FROM metrics-apachereceiver.otel-*
| STATS busy_workers = AVG(metrics.apache.workers) WHERE attributes.state == "busy",
        idle_workers = AVG(metrics.apache.workers) WHERE attributes.state == "idle"
  BY resource.attributes.host.name
| WHERE busy_workers IS NOT NULL AND idle_workers IS NOT NULL
| EVAL total_workers = busy_workers + idle_workers
| WHERE total_workers > 0
| EVAL busy_ratio = busy_workers / total_workers
| WHERE busy_ratio > 0.85
| EVAL busy_ratio = ROUND(busy_ratio, 3)
| KEEP resource.attributes.host.name, busy_workers, idle_workers, total_workers, busy_ratio
| SORT busy_ratio DESC

apache_otel-throughput-high-request-rate.name: [Apache OTel] High request rate
apache_otel-throughput-high-request-rate.esql:
// Alert triggers when the request rate exceeds the threshold.
// High request rate may indicate unexpected traffic spikes or potential DDoS attacks.
// Uses delta calculation for counter metric (requests is cumulative).
// The alert is grouped by host name.
// You can adjust the threshold value by modifying the request_rate in the WHERE clause (default: > 1000 requests/min).
FROM metrics-apachereceiver.otel-*
| STATS max_requests = MAX(metrics.apache.requests), min_requests = MIN(metrics.apache.requests),
        first_ts = MIN(@timestamp), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY resource.attributes.host.name
| EVAL request_delta = max_requests - min_requests
| EVAL request_delta = CASE(request_delta >= 0, request_delta, 0)
| EVAL elapsed_sec = TO_DOUBLE(TO_LONG(last_ts) - TO_LONG(first_ts)) / 1000
| WHERE elapsed_sec >= 60
| EVAL request_rate = (request_delta / elapsed_sec) * 60
| WHERE request_rate > 1000
| EVAL request_rate = ROUND(request_rate, 2)
| KEEP resource.attributes.host.name, request_delta, request_rate, elapsed_sec
| SORT request_rate DESC

apache_otel-worker-pool-exhaustion.name: [Apache OTel] Worker pool exhaustion
apache_otel-worker-pool-exhaustion.esql:
FROM metrics-apachereceiver.otel-*
| WHERE apache.workers IS NOT NULL
| STATS total = SUM(apache.workers),
        busy = SUM(apache.workers) WHERE attributes.state == "busy"
    BY resource.attributes.apache.server.name
| WHERE total > 0
| EVAL utilization_pct = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(busy) / TO_DOUBLE(total) * 100.0, 2)
| WHERE utilization_pct > 80.0
| SORT utilization_pct DESC
| LIMIT 10

apache_tomcat_otel-connection-pool-satur.name: [Tomcat OTel] Connection pool saturation
apache_tomcat_otel-connection-pool-satur.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE Catalina_ThreadPool_connectionCount IS NOT NULL
    AND Catalina_ThreadPool_maxConnections IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    connections = MAX(Catalina_ThreadPool_connectionCount),
    max_connections = MAX(Catalina_ThreadPool_maxConnections)
  BY host.name, attributes.name
| WHERE max_connections > 0
| EVAL connection_pct = ROUND(connections / max_connections * 100.0, 2)
// Connection saturation threshold — when keep-alive connections accumulate
// they can starve new connections; adjust based on connector capacity planning
| WHERE connection_pct > 80.0
| SORT connection_pct DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-file-descriptor-exhau.name: [Tomcat OTel] File descriptor exhaustion
apache_tomcat_otel-file-descriptor-exhau.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE java_lang_OperatingSystem_OpenFileDescriptorCount IS NOT NULL
    AND java_lang_OperatingSystem_MaxFileDescriptorCount IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    open_fds = MAX(java_lang_OperatingSystem_OpenFileDescriptorCount),
    max_fds = MAX(java_lang_OperatingSystem_MaxFileDescriptorCount)
  BY host.name
| WHERE max_fds > 0
| EVAL fd_pct = ROUND(open_fds / max_fds * 100.0, 2)
// File descriptor exhaustion prevents new socket connections and file operations
// Adjust threshold based on your FD limits (ulimit -n)
| WHERE fd_pct > 80.0
| SORT fd_pct DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-high-jvm-process-cpu.name: [Tomcat OTel] High JVM process CPU usage

apache_tomcat_otel-high-request-error-ra.name: [Tomcat OTel] High request error rate
apache_tomcat_otel-high-request-error-ra.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_errorCount IS NOT NULL
    AND Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    max_errors = MAX(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_errorCount),
    min_errors = MIN(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_errorCount),
    max_requests = MAX(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount),
    min_requests = MIN(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount)
  BY host.name, attributes.name
| EVAL
    delta_errors = max_errors - min_errors,
    delta_requests = max_requests - min_requests
// Minimum request volume to avoid noisy alerts on low-traffic connectors
// Adjust this threshold based on expected traffic volume
| WHERE delta_requests > 10
| EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(delta_errors / delta_requests * 100.0, 2)
// Alert threshold — adjust based on acceptable error rate for your services
| WHERE error_rate_pct > 5.0
| SORT error_rate_pct DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-jvm-heap-memory-press.name: [Tomcat OTel] JVM heap memory pressure
apache_tomcat_otel-jvm-heap-memory-press.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used IS NOT NULL
    AND java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    heap_used = MAX(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used),
    heap_max = MAX(java_lang_Memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max)
  BY host.name
// HeapMemoryUsage_max can be -1 if undefined; filter to valid values
| WHERE heap_max > 0
| EVAL heap_pct = ROUND(heap_used / heap_max * 100.0, 2)
// Heap utilisation threshold — peaks above 85% indicate memory pressure
// Sustained high utilisation often precedes OutOfMemoryError
| WHERE heap_pct > 85.0
| SORT heap_pct DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-old-generation-gc-act.name: [Tomcat OTel] Old generation GC activity
apache_tomcat_otel-old-generation-gc-act.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE java_lang_G1_Old_Generation_CollectionCount IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    max_count = MAX(java_lang_G1_Old_Generation_CollectionCount),
    min_count = MIN(java_lang_G1_Old_Generation_CollectionCount)
  BY host.name
| EVAL full_gc_count = max_count - min_count
// Any old generation (full) GC pauses the entire JVM and directly impacts latency
// Frequent full GC (> 1/min) is critical — adjust threshold to match your GC tuning
| WHERE full_gc_count > 0
| SORT full_gc_count DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-request-latency-spike.name: [Tomcat OTel] Request latency spike
apache_tomcat_otel-request-latency-spike.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_processingTime IS NOT NULL
    AND Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    max_time = MAX(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_processingTime),
    min_time = MIN(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_processingTime),
    max_requests = MAX(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount),
    min_requests = MIN(Catalina_GlobalRequestProcessor_requestCount)
  BY host.name, attributes.name
| EVAL
    delta_time_ms = max_time - min_time,
    delta_requests = max_requests - min_requests
// Minimum request volume to compute a meaningful average
| WHERE delta_requests > 10
| EVAL avg_latency_ms = ROUND(delta_time_ms / delta_requests, 2)
// Latency threshold in milliseconds — adjust based on your SLA
// Consider that this is average latency; tail latency will be higher
| WHERE avg_latency_ms > 500.0
| SORT avg_latency_ms DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-session-rejection.name: [Tomcat OTel] Session rejection
apache_tomcat_otel-session-rejection.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE Catalina_Manager_rejectedSessions IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    max_rejected = MAX(Catalina_Manager_rejectedSessions),
    min_rejected = MIN(Catalina_Manager_rejectedSessions)
  BY host.name, attributes.context, attributes.host
| EVAL new_rejections = max_rejected - min_rejected
// Any session rejection means maxActiveSessions has been reached
// This directly impacts users who cannot establish new sessions
| WHERE new_rejections > 0
| SORT new_rejections DESC

apache_tomcat_otel-thread-pool-saturatio.name: [Tomcat OTel] Thread pool saturation
apache_tomcat_otel-thread-pool-saturatio.esql:
FROM metrics-tomcat.otel-*
| WHERE Catalina_ThreadPool_currentThreadsBusy IS NOT NULL
    AND Catalina_ThreadPool_maxThreads IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    busy = MAX(Catalina_ThreadPool_currentThreadsBusy),
    max_threads = MAX(Catalina_ThreadPool_maxThreads)
  BY host.name, attributes.name
| WHERE max_threads > 0
| EVAL utilization_pct = ROUND(busy / max_threads * 100.0, 2)
// Thread pool saturation threshold — adjust based on your capacity requirements
// Above 80% the risk of request queuing and rejection increases rapidly
| WHERE utilization_pct > 80.0
| SORT utilization_pct DESC

cassandra_otel-compaction-pending.name: [Cassandra OTel] Compaction falling behind (pending tasks)
cassandra_otel-compaction-pending.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// Gauge: pending compaction tasks; > 0 means compaction is falling behind
| WHERE cassandra.compaction.tasks.pending IS NOT NULL
| STATS pending = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(cassandra.compaction.tasks.pending)) BY server.address
// Any persistent backlog degrades read performance
| WHERE pending > 0
| SORT pending DESC

cassandra_otel-high-error-rate.name: [Cassandra OTel] High error rate by node
cassandra_otel-high-error-rate.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// Combine request count and error count per node via FORK
| FORK (
    WHERE cassandra.client.request.count IS NOT NULL
    | STATS requests = SUM(INCREASE(cassandra.client.request.count)) BY server.address
    | EVAL errors = 0.0
  )
  (
    WHERE cassandra.client.request.error.count IS NOT NULL
    | STATS errors = SUM(INCREASE(cassandra.client.request.error.count)) BY server.address
    | EVAL requests = 0.0
  )
| STATS total_requests = SUM(requests), total_errors = SUM(errors) BY server.address
// Minimum sample size to avoid noisy low-traffic nodes
| WHERE total_requests > 10
| EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(total_errors / total_requests * 100.0, 2)
// Threshold: 5% error rate; tune for your tolerance
| WHERE error_rate_pct > 5.0
| SORT error_rate_pct DESC

cassandra_otel-high-range-slice-latency-.name: [Cassandra OTel] High range slice latency (p99)
cassandra_otel-high-range-slice-latency-.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// RangeSlice (range scans, secondary index) latency; inherently higher than single-partition reads
| WHERE `cassandra.client.request.range_slice.latency.99p` IS NOT NULL
| STATS p99_us = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cassandra.client.request.range_slice.latency.99p`)) BY server.address
// Threshold: 500000 us = 500 ms; range scans are more expensive
| WHERE p99_us > 500000
| SORT p99_us DESC

cassandra_otel-high-read-latency-p99.name: [Cassandra OTel] High read latency (p99)
cassandra_otel-high-read-latency-p99.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// p99 read latency in microseconds; backtick-quote field names with numeric segments
| WHERE `cassandra.client.request.read.latency.99p` IS NOT NULL
| STATS p99_us = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cassandra.client.request.read.latency.99p`)) BY server.address
// Threshold: 100000 us = 100 ms; tune for your SLA
| WHERE p99_us > 100000
| SORT p99_us DESC

cassandra_otel-high-write-latency-p99.name: [Cassandra OTel] High write latency (p99)
cassandra_otel-high-write-latency-p99.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// p99 write latency in microseconds
| WHERE `cassandra.client.request.write.latency.99p` IS NOT NULL
| STATS p99_us = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cassandra.client.request.write.latency.99p`)) BY server.address
// Threshold: 50000 us = 50 ms; writes typically lower than reads
| WHERE p99_us > 50000
| SORT p99_us DESC

cassandra_otel-hints-in-progress.name: [Cassandra OTel] Hints in progress (replicas unreachable)
cassandra_otel-hints-in-progress.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// Gauge: hints currently being sent; > 0 means replicas are unreachable
| WHERE cassandra.storage.total_hints.in_progress.count IS NOT NULL
| STATS hints_in_progress = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(cassandra.storage.total_hints.in_progress.count)) BY server.address
| WHERE hints_in_progress > 0
| SORT hints_in_progress DESC

cassandra_otel-request-errors.name: [Cassandra OTel] Request errors (Timeout, Unavailable, Failure)
cassandra_otel-request-errors.esql:
TS metrics-cassandra.otel-default
// Counter metric: use INCREASE for absolute error count in window
| WHERE cassandra.client.request.error.count IS NOT NULL
| STATS error_count = SUM(INCREASE(cassandra.client.request.error.count)) BY server.address, attributes.operation, attributes.status
| WHERE error_count > 0
| SORT error_count DESC

cockroachdb_otel-cpu-overload.name: [CockroachDB OTel] CPU utilization high
cockroachdb_otel-cpu-overload.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND sys_cpu_combined_percent_normalized IS NOT NULL
  AND sys_cpu_combined_percent_normalized > 0.8
// Node-level: CockroachDB process CPU; > 0.8 indicates overload
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
| STATS cpu_pct = ROUND(MAX(sys_cpu_combined_percent_normalized) * 100.0, 1) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| SORT cpu_pct DESC

cockroachdb_otel-deadlocks-detected.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Deadlocks detected
cockroachdb_otel-deadlocks-detected.esql:
TS metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND txnwaitqueue_deadlocks_total IS NOT NULL
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
// INCREASE for counter: any increase indicates deadlocks detected
| STATS deadlocks = SUM(INCREASE(txnwaitqueue_deadlocks_total)) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| WHERE deadlocks > 0
| SORT deadlocks DESC

cockroachdb_otel-disk-io-bottleneck.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Disk I/O operations queued high
cockroachdb_otel-disk-io-bottleneck.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND sys_host_disk_iopsinprogress IS NOT NULL
  AND sys_host_disk_iopsinprogress > 10
// Persistent double digits indicate I/O bottleneck
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
| STATS iops_queued = MAX(sys_host_disk_iopsinprogress) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| SORT iops_queued DESC

cockroachdb_otel-goroutines-overload.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Runnable goroutines per CPU high
cockroachdb_otel-goroutines-overload.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND sys_runnable_goroutines_per_cpu IS NOT NULL
  AND sys_runnable_goroutines_per_cpu > 30
// Values > 30 indicate CPU overload
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
| STATS goroutines_per_cpu = MAX(sys_runnable_goroutines_per_cpu) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| SORT goroutines_per_cpu DESC

cockroachdb_otel-io-admission-overload.name: [CockroachDB OTel] IO admission control overload
cockroachdb_otel-io-admission-overload.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND admission_io_overload IS NOT NULL
  AND admission_io_overload > 1.0
// Values > 1.0 indicate storage overload; adjust threshold if needed
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS overload = MAX(admission_io_overload) BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT overload DESC

cockroachdb_otel-l0-files-high.name: [CockroachDB OTel] L0 file count high
cockroachdb_otel-l0-files-high.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND storage_l0_num_files IS NOT NULL
  AND storage_l0_num_files > 1000
// > 1000 indicates compaction falling behind
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS l0_files = MAX(storage_l0_num_files) BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT l0_files DESC

cockroachdb_otel-liveness-heartbeat-fail.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Liveness heartbeat failures
cockroachdb_otel-liveness-heartbeat-fail.esql:
TS metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND liveness_heartbeatfailures IS NOT NULL
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
// INCREASE for counter: any increase indicates heartbeat failures
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(liveness_heartbeatfailures)) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| WHERE increase > 0
| SORT increase DESC

cockroachdb_otel-lsm-read-amplification.name: [CockroachDB OTel] LSM read amplification high
cockroachdb_otel-lsm-read-amplification.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND rocksdb_read_amplification IS NOT NULL
  AND rocksdb_read_amplification > 50
// > 50 for sustained period indicates unhealthy LSM
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS amplification = MAX(rocksdb_read_amplification) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| SORT amplification DESC

cockroachdb_otel-rpc-unhealthy.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Unhealthy RPC connections
cockroachdb_otel-rpc-unhealthy.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND rpc_connection_unhealthy IS NOT NULL
  AND rpc_connection_unhealthy > 0
// > 0 indicates possible network partition
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NULL
| STATS unhealthy = MAX(rpc_connection_unhealthy) BY attributes.node_id, host.name
| SORT unhealthy DESC

cockroachdb_otel-storage-capacity-high.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Storage capacity usage high
cockroachdb_otel-storage-capacity-high.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND capacity IS NOT NULL
  AND capacity > 0
  AND capacity_used IS NOT NULL
// Used should not exceed 60% of total; adjust ratio if needed
| EVAL usage_ratio = capacity_used / capacity
| WHERE usage_ratio > 0.6
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS usage_pct = ROUND(MAX(usage_ratio) * 100.0, 1), used_gb = ROUND(MAX(capacity_used) / 1073741824.0, 1), total_gb = ROUND(MAX(capacity) / 1073741824.0, 1)
  BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT usage_pct DESC

cockroachdb_otel-storage-write-stalls.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Storage write stalls detected
cockroachdb_otel-storage-write-stalls.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND storage_write_stalls IS NOT NULL
  AND storage_write_stalls > 0
// Store-level metric: intentional write stalls due to disk backpressure
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS stalls = MAX(storage_write_stalls) BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT stalls DESC

cockroachdb_otel-unavailable-ranges.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Unavailable ranges detected
cockroachdb_otel-unavailable-ranges.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND ranges_unavailable IS NOT NULL
  AND ranges_unavailable > 0
// Store-level metric: both node_id and store must be present
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS unavailable = MAX(ranges_unavailable) BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT unavailable DESC

cockroachdb_otel-underreplicated-ranges.name: [CockroachDB OTel] Under-replicated ranges detected
cockroachdb_otel-underreplicated-ranges.esql:
FROM metrics-cockroachdb.otel-default*
| WHERE service.name == "cockroachdb"
  AND ranges_underreplicated IS NOT NULL
  AND ranges_underreplicated > 0
// Store-level metric
| WHERE attributes.node_id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.store IS NOT NULL
| STATS underreplicated = MAX(ranges_underreplicated) BY attributes.node_id, attributes.store, host.name
| SORT underreplicated DESC

couchdb_otel-conflict-storm.name: [CouchDB OTel] Conflict storm (elevated 409 responses)
couchdb_otel-conflict-storm.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// 409 = update conflicts — spikes indicate write contention on same documents
| WHERE attributes.http.status_code == "409"
| STATS conflict_rate = SUM(RATE(couchdb.httpd.responses))
  BY couchdb.node.name
// Tune threshold: 409/s may be normal under load; >10/s often signals contention
| WHERE conflict_rate > 10.0
| SORT conflict_rate DESC
| LIMIT 20

couchdb_otel-file-descriptor-exhaustion.name: [CouchDB OTel] File descriptor exhaustion risk
couchdb_otel-file-descriptor-exhaustion.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// Open file descriptors is a gauge — use LAST_OVER_TIME for current state
| WHERE couchdb.file_descriptor.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS open_fds = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(couchdb.file_descriptor.open))
  BY couchdb.node.name
// Typical ulimit is 1024–65536 — adjust threshold for your environment
| WHERE open_fds > 1000
| SORT open_fds DESC
| LIMIT 20

couchdb_otel-high-5xx-rate.name: [CouchDB OTel] High 5xx server error rate
couchdb_otel-high-5xx-rate.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// Aggregate request rate and 5xx error rate per CouchDB node
| STATS
    total_rate = SUM(RATE(couchdb.httpd.responses)),
    errors_5xx_rate = SUM(RATE(couchdb.httpd.responses)) WHERE attributes.http.status_code IN ("500", "501", "503")
  BY couchdb.node.name
// Minimum traffic to avoid noisy low-volume nodes
| WHERE total_rate > 0.01
// 5xx as percentage of total responses — tune threshold (default 5%)
| EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(errors_5xx_rate / total_rate * 100.0, 2)
| WHERE error_rate_pct > 5.0
| SORT error_rate_pct DESC
| LIMIT 20

couchdb_otel-high-average-request-time.name: [CouchDB OTel] High average request time (latency)
couchdb_otel-high-average-request-time.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// Average request time is a gauge — use MAX_OVER_TIME for peak detection
| WHERE couchdb.average_request_time IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_avg_request_time_ms = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(couchdb.average_request_time))
  BY couchdb.node.name
// Latency threshold in ms — adjust for your SLO (e.g. 500–2000 ms)
| WHERE max_avg_request_time_ms > 1000
| SORT max_avg_request_time_ms DESC
| LIMIT 20

couchdb_otel-high-error-rate.name: [CouchDB OTel] High error rate (4xx and 5xx)
couchdb_otel-high-error-rate.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// Aggregate total and error (4xx+5xx) response rates per node
| STATS
    total_rate = SUM(RATE(couchdb.httpd.responses)),
    error_rate = SUM(RATE(couchdb.httpd.responses)) WHERE attributes.http.status_code IN ("400", "401", "403", "404", "405", "406", "409", "412", "413", "414", "415", "416", "417", "500", "501", "503")
  BY couchdb.node.name
| WHERE total_rate > 0.01
// Error rate as percentage — tune threshold for your error budget
| EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(error_rate / total_rate * 100.0, 2)
| WHERE error_rate_pct > 10.0
| SORT error_rate_pct DESC
| LIMIT 20

couchdb_otel-open-databases-high.name: [CouchDB OTel] Open databases count high
couchdb_otel-open-databases-high.esql:
TS metrics-couchdbreceiver.otel-default
// Open databases is a gauge — use LAST_OVER_TIME for current state
| WHERE couchdb.database.open IS NOT NULL
| STATS open_databases = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(couchdb.database.open))
  BY couchdb.node.name
// Unbounded growth indicates DB proliferation or leak — tune threshold
| WHERE open_databases > 100
| SORT open_databases DESC
| LIMIT 20

envoyproxy_otel-certificate-expiring-soo.name: [Envoy OTel] Certificate expiring soon
envoyproxy_otel-certificate-expiring-soo.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.server.days_until_first_cert_expiring IS NOT NULL
// Days until first TLS cert expires — alert when below threshold
| STATS min_days = MIN(envoy.server.days_until_first_cert_expiring)
// Adjust threshold (7 days) based on your cert renewal lead time
| WHERE min_days < 7

envoyproxy_otel-high-downstream-error-ra.name: [Envoy OTel] High downstream error rate
envoyproxy_otel-high-downstream-error-ra.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
// Aggregate across HTTP stat_prefixes (ingress_http, admin) — add more COALESCE terms as needed
| EVAL total_rq = COALESCE(envoy.http.ingress_http.downstream_rq_completed, 0::long)
    + COALESCE(envoy.http.admin.downstream_rq_completed, 0::long)
| EVAL success_rq = COALESCE(envoy.http.ingress_http.downstream_rq_2xx, 0::long)
    + COALESCE(envoy.http.admin.downstream_rq_2xx, 0::long)
| WHERE total_rq > 50
| EVAL error_rate = TO_DOUBLE(total_rq - success_rq) / TO_DOUBLE(total_rq) * 100.0
| STATS max_error_rate = MAX(error_rate)
// Healthy: < 1%; Unhealthy: > 5%. Adjust threshold for your SLO.
| WHERE max_error_rate > 5.0

envoyproxy_otel-high-memory-pressure.name: [Envoy OTel] High memory pressure
envoyproxy_otel-high-memory-pressure.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.server.memory_allocated IS NOT NULL
    AND envoy.server.memory_heap_size IS NOT NULL
    AND envoy.server.memory_heap_size > 0
// Ratio of allocated to heap — sustained high values indicate pressure or leak
| EVAL mem_ratio = envoy.server.memory_allocated / envoy.server.memory_heap_size
| STATS max_ratio = MAX(mem_ratio)
// Adjust threshold (0.9 = 90%) based on your memory headroom expectations
| WHERE max_ratio > 0.9

envoyproxy_otel-listeners-warming.name: [Envoy OTel] Listeners warming
envoyproxy_otel-listeners-warming.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.listener_manager.total_listeners_warming IS NOT NULL
// Listeners warming should drop to 0 after config load
| STATS max_warming = MAX(envoy.listener_manager.total_listeners_warming)
| WHERE max_warming > 0

envoyproxy_otel-server-not-live.name: [Envoy OTel] Server not live
envoyproxy_otel-server-not-live.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.server.live IS NOT NULL
// Server live is 1 when healthy, 0 when not
| STATS max_live = MAX(envoy.server.live)
| WHERE max_live < 1

envoyproxy_otel-server-state-not-live.name: [Envoy OTel] Server state not LIVE
envoyproxy_otel-server-state-not-live.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.server.state IS NOT NULL
// state: 0=LIVE, 1=DRAINING, 2=PRE_INITIALIZING, 3=INITIALIZING
| STATS max_state = MAX(envoy.server.state)
| WHERE max_state != 0

envoyproxy_otel-warming-clusters-stuck.name: [Envoy OTel] Warming clusters stuck
envoyproxy_otel-warming-clusters-stuck.esql:
FROM metrics-statsdreceiver-default
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "statsdreceiver"
| WHERE envoy.cluster_manager.warming_clusters IS NOT NULL
// Warming clusters should drop to 0 after config load; sustained > 0 indicates config issues
| STATS max_warming = MAX(envoy.cluster_manager.warming_clusters)
| WHERE max_warming > 0

etcd_otel-db-size-quota.name: [etcd OTel] Database size approaching quota
etcd_otel-db-size-quota.esql:
FROM metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// DB size vs quota: when ratio reaches 1, etcd enters alarm mode and rejects writes
| WHERE etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes IS NOT NULL
  AND etcd_server_quota_backend_bytes IS NOT NULL
  AND etcd_server_quota_backend_bytes > 0
| EVAL usage_ratio = etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes * 1.0 / etcd_server_quota_backend_bytes
// Alert when usage exceeds 90%; adjust threshold for earlier warning
| WHERE usage_ratio > 0.9
| STATS usage_ratio = MAX(usage_ratio),
    db_bytes = MAX(etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes),
    quota_bytes = MAX(etcd_server_quota_backend_bytes)
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| SORT usage_ratio DESC

etcd_otel-file-descriptor-exhaustion.name: [etcd OTel] File descriptor exhaustion
etcd_otel-file-descriptor-exhaustion.esql:
FROM metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Gauge: open FDs vs max; exhaustion causes connection failures
| WHERE process_open_fds IS NOT NULL
  AND process_max_fds IS NOT NULL
  AND process_max_fds > 0
| EVAL fd_ratio = process_open_fds * 1.0 / process_max_fds
// Alert when usage exceeds 90%; adjust for earlier warning
| WHERE fd_ratio > 0.9
| STATS fd_ratio = MAX(fd_ratio),
    open_fds = MAX(process_open_fds),
    max_fds = MAX(process_max_fds)
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| SORT fd_ratio DESC

etcd_otel-grpc-errors.name: [etcd OTel] gRPC errors
etcd_otel-grpc-errors.esql:
TS metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Counter with attributes.grpc_code: non-OK codes indicate client/auth/overload issues
| WHERE grpc_server_handled_total IS NOT NULL
  AND attributes.grpc_code != "OK"
| STATS errors = SUM(INCREASE(grpc_server_handled_total))
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| WHERE errors > 0
| SORT errors DESC

etcd_otel-heartbeat-failures.name: [etcd OTel] Heartbeat send failures
etcd_otel-heartbeat-failures.esql:
TS metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Counter: leader failing to send heartbeats to followers; precursor to leader elections
| WHERE etcd_server_heartbeat_send_failures_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(etcd_server_heartbeat_send_failures_total))
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| WHERE increase > 0
| SORT increase DESC

etcd_otel-leader-changes.name: [etcd OTel] Frequent leader elections
etcd_otel-leader-changes.esql:
TS metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Counter: leader changes observed; frequent elections suggest disk I/O, network, or resource issues
| WHERE etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS changes = SUM(INCREASE(etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total))
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
// Alert when more than 1 leader change in window; adjust threshold for sensitivity
| WHERE changes > 1
| SORT changes DESC

etcd_otel-no-leader.name: [etcd OTel] No leader
etcd_otel-no-leader.esql:
FROM metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Member has no leader: network partition, quorum lost, or all members down
| WHERE etcd_server_has_leader IS NOT NULL
  AND etcd_server_has_leader == 0
// Group by instance for per-member alerting
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| SORT count DESC

etcd_otel-proposals-failed.name: [etcd OTel] Proposal failures
etcd_otel-proposals-failed.esql:
TS metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Counter: failed Raft proposals indicate lost quorum or severe network issues
| WHERE etcd_server_proposals_failed_total IS NOT NULL
// INCREASE: any increase in the window indicates failures
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(etcd_server_proposals_failed_total))
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| WHERE increase > 0
| SORT increase DESC

etcd_otel-proposals-pending.name: [etcd OTel] Pending proposals backlog
etcd_otel-proposals-pending.esql:
FROM metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Gauge: proposals waiting to be committed; backlog indicates leader overload or slow disk
| WHERE etcd_server_proposals_pending IS NOT NULL
  AND etcd_server_proposals_pending > 10
// Adjust threshold (10) based on expected write throughput
| STATS pending = MAX(etcd_server_proposals_pending)
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| SORT pending DESC

etcd_otel-slow-applies.name: [etcd OTel] Slow apply operations
etcd_otel-slow-applies.esql:
TS metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Counter: Raft applies that exceeded expected duration (~100ms); indicates slow disk or compaction contention
| WHERE etcd_server_slow_apply_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(etcd_server_slow_apply_total))
    BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id
| WHERE increase > 0
| SORT increase DESC

etcd_otel-target-down.name: [etcd OTel] Scrape target down
etcd_otel-target-down.esql:
FROM metrics-etcd.otel-default*
// Scrape health: up=0 when Prometheus/OTel collector cannot reach the etcd metrics endpoint
| WHERE `up` IS NOT NULL
  AND `up` == 0
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.service.instance.id

haproxy_otel-requests-queued.name: [HAProxy OTel] Requests queued at backend

haproxy_otel-response-errors-spike.name: [HAProxy OTel] Response errors spike
haproxy_otel-response-errors-spike.esql:

haproxy_otel-retry-redispatch-spike.name: [HAProxy OTel] Connection retries or redispatches spike
haproxy_otel-retry-redispatch-spike.esql:
TS metrics-haproxyreceiver.otel-*
// Retries and redispatches — backend instability signals
| WHERE haproxy.connections.retries IS NOT NULL OR haproxy.requests.redispatched IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    retry_inc = SUM(INCREASE(haproxy.connections.retries)),
    redis_inc = SUM(INCREASE(haproxy.requests.redispatched))
  BY haproxy.proxy_name, haproxy.service_name, haproxy.addr
| EVAL retry_inc = COALESCE(retry_inc, 0), redis_inc = COALESCE(redis_inc, 0)
| EVAL total_instability = retry_inc + redis_inc
| WHERE total_instability > 5
| EVAL alert_key = CONCAT(TO_STRING(haproxy.proxy_name), "::", TO_STRING(haproxy.service_name), "::", COALESCE(TO_STRING(haproxy.addr), ""))
| SORT total_instability DESC

haproxy_otel-session-saturation.name: [HAProxy OTel] Session saturation approaching limit
haproxy_otel-session-saturation.esql:
FROM metrics-haproxyreceiver.otel-*

| WHERE haproxy.sessions.limit > 0
| STATS
    max_sessions = MAX(haproxy.sessions.count),
    max_limit = MAX(haproxy.sessions.limit)
  BY haproxy.proxy_name, haproxy.service_name, haproxy.addr
| EVAL utilisation_pct = ROUND(max_sessions * 100.0 / max_limit, 1)
// Alert when utilisation exceeds 80% — adjust for capacity planning
| WHERE utilisation_pct > 80
| EVAL alert_key = CONCAT(TO_STRING(haproxy.proxy_name), "::", TO_STRING(haproxy.service_name), "::", COALESCE(TO_STRING(haproxy.addr), ""))
| SORT utilisation_pct DESC

FROM metrics-influxdb.otel-*
// Shard dropped points (cumulative) and cache dropped writes (cumulative)
| WHERE COALESCE(metrics.storage_shard_write_dropped_sum, storage_shard_write_dropped_sum) IS NOT NULL
    OR COALESCE(metrics.storage_cache_writes_dropped, storage_cache_writes_dropped) IS NOT NULL
// Detect increase in dropped points over the window
| STATS min_shard_drop = MIN(COALESCE(metrics.storage_shard_write_dropped_sum, storage_shard_write_dropped_sum)),
    max_shard_drop = MAX(COALESCE(metrics.storage_shard_write_dropped_sum, storage_shard_write_dropped_sum)),
    min_cache_drop = MIN(COALESCE(metrics.storage_cache_writes_dropped, storage_cache_writes_dropped)),

  BY host.name

    cache_drop_increase = max_cache_drop - min_cache_drop
// Alert when any new dropped writes occurred (data loss risk)
| WHERE shard_drop_increase > 0 OR cache_drop_increase > 0

kubernetes_otel-daemonset-mis-scheduled.name: [Kubernetes OTel] DaemonSet mis-scheduled or not ready

| WHERE k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    desired = LAST(k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes, @timestamp),
    current = LAST(k8s.daemonset.current_scheduled_nodes, @timestamp),
    ready = LAST(k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes, @timestamp),
    misscheduled = LAST(k8s.daemonset.misscheduled_nodes, @timestamp)
    BY k8s.daemonset.name, k8s.namespace.name
// Alert when pods are misscheduled OR not all desired nodes are ready
| WHERE misscheduled > 0
    OR ready < desired
| EVAL not_ready = desired - ready
| KEEP k8s.namespace.name, k8s.daemonset.name, desired, ready, not_ready, misscheduled

kubernetes_otel-deployment-unavailable-r.name: [Kubernetes OTel] Deployment unavailable replicas

// Only alert for deployments that should have replicas running
| WHERE desired > 0
// Alert when available replicas are fewer than desired
| WHERE available < desired
| EVAL unavailable = desired - available
| KEEP k8s.namespace.name, k8s.deployment.name, desired, available, unavailable
| SORT unavailable DESC

kubernetes_otel-hpa-at-max-replicas.name: [Kubernetes OTel] HPA at max replicas

kubernetes_otel-persistent-volume-space-.name: [Kubernetes OTel] Persistent volume space low

    AND k8s.volume.capacity IS NOT NULL
    AND k8s.volume.capacity > 0

| LIMIT 50

kubernetes_otel-pod-crashloopbackoff.name: [Kubernetes OTel] Pod CrashLoopBackOff

kubernetes_otel-pods-failed-phase.name: [Kubernetes OTel] Pods in Failed phase
kubernetes_otel-pods-failed-phase.esql:
TS metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE k8s.pod.phase IS NOT NULL
| STATS observed_phases = VALUES(k8s.pod.phase)
    BY k8s.pod.name, k8s.namespace.name, k8s.node.name
// Phase 4 = Failed — alert if any data point in the window showed Failed,
// even if the pod has since transitioned to another phase
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(observed_phases, TO_LONG(4))
| EVAL status = "Failed"
| KEEP k8s.namespace.name, k8s.pod.name, k8s.node.name, status, observed_phases
| SORT k8s.namespace.name ASC, k8s.pod.name ASC
| LIMIT 100

kubernetes_otel-pods-pending-phase.name: [Kubernetes OTel] Pods stuck in Pending phase
kubernetes_otel-pods-pending-phase.esql:
TS metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE k8s.pod.phase IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_phase = MAX(k8s.pod.phase)
    BY k8s.pod.name, k8s.namespace.name, k8s.node.name
// Phase 1 = Pending — alert only if the pod never progressed beyond Pending
// in the window. If it reached Running (2) or beyond, MAX > 1 and it drops out.
| WHERE max_phase == 1
| EVAL status = "Pending"
| KEEP k8s.namespace.name, k8s.pod.name, k8s.node.name, status
| SORT k8s.namespace.name ASC, k8s.pod.name ASC
| LIMIT 100

kubernetes_otel-statefulset-replicas-not.name: [Kubernetes OTel] StatefulSet replicas not ready
kubernetes_otel-statefulset-replicas-not.esql:
TS metrics-k8sclusterreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE k8s.statefulset.desired_pods IS NOT NULL
    AND k8s.statefulset.ready_pods IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    desired = LAST(k8s.statefulset.desired_pods, @timestamp),
    ready = LAST(k8s.statefulset.ready_pods, @timestamp)
    BY k8s.statefulset.name, k8s.namespace.name
// Exclude StatefulSets scaled to zero
| WHERE desired > 0
// Alert when ready pods are fewer than desired
| WHERE ready < desired
| EVAL not_ready = desired - ready
| KEEP k8s.namespace.name, k8s.statefulset.name, desired, ready, not_ready
| SORT not_ready DESC

memcached_otel-high-connection-count.name: [Memcached OTel] High connection count
memcached_otel-high-connection-count.esql:
TS metrics-memcachedreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE memcached.connections.current IS NOT NULL
// Current connections (gauge) — use max over window for peak detection
| STATS max_connections = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(memcached.connections.current))
  BY host.name, COALESCE(service.instance.id, host.name)
// Alert when connections exceed 800 — adjust for your -c limit
| WHERE max_connections > 800
| SORT max_connections DESC
| LIMIT 20

memcached_otel-high-cpu-usage.name: [Memcached OTel] High CPU usage
memcached_otel-high-cpu-usage.esql:
TS metrics-memcachedreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE memcached.cpu.usage IS NOT NULL
// CPU usage is cumulative seconds (system + user) — RATE gives cores in use
| STATS cpu_cores = SUM(RATE(memcached.cpu.usage))
  BY host.name, COALESCE(service.instance.id, host.name)
// Alert when CPU exceeds 0.8 cores — memcached is typically CPU-light
| WHERE cpu_cores > 0.8
| SORT cpu_cores DESC
| LIMIT 20

memcached_otel-high-eviction-rate.name: [Memcached OTel] High eviction rate
memcached_otel-high-eviction-rate.esql:
TS metrics-memcachedreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE memcached.evictions IS NOT NULL
// Eviction rate (evictions/sec) — rising evictions indicate memory pressure
| STATS eviction_rate = SUM(RATE(memcached.evictions))
  BY host.name, COALESCE(service.instance.id, host.name)
// Alert when eviction rate exceeds 10/sec — tune for your workload
| WHERE eviction_rate > 10.0
| SORT eviction_rate DESC
| LIMIT 20

memcached_otel-low-command-throughput.name: [Memcached OTel] Low command throughput
memcached_otel-low-command-throughput.esql:
TS metrics-memcachedreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE memcached.commands IS NOT NULL
// Total command rate across all types (get, set, flush, touch)
| STATS cmd_rate = SUM(RATE(memcached.commands))
  BY host.name, COALESCE(service.instance.id, host.name)
// Alert when throughput drops below 1 cmd/sec — indicates cache is idle or unreachable
| WHERE cmd_rate < 1.0
| SORT cmd_rate ASC
| LIMIT 20

memcached_otel-low-hit-ratio.name: [Memcached OTel] Low hit ratio for get operations
memcached_otel-low-hit-ratio.esql:
FROM metrics-memcachedreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE memcached.operation_hit_ratio IS NOT NULL
| WHERE operation == "get" OR attributes.operation == "get"
// Bug: operation_hit_ratio actually reports miss ratio (see OTel contrib #30695)
// True hit ratio = 100 - miss_ratio. Alert when hit ratio < 80% (miss > 20%)
| STATS miss_ratio_pct = AVG(memcached.operation_hit_ratio), hit_ratio = 100.0 - AVG(memcached.operation_hit_ratio)
  BY host.name, COALESCE(service.instance.id, host.name)
| WHERE miss_ratio_pct > 20.0
| SORT miss_ratio_pct DESC
| LIMIT 20

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-blocked-process.name: [SQL Server OTel] Blocked processes
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-blocked-process.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Non-zero blocked processes means active blocking chains
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.processes.blocked IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_blocked = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.processes.blocked),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE max_blocked > 0
| KEEP instance_id, max_blocked

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-buffer-cache-hi.name: [SQL Server OTel] Buffer cache hit ratio low
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-buffer-cache-hi.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Instance-level metric: buffer cache hit ratio as percentage (0-100)
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.page.buffer_cache.hit_ratio IS NOT NULL
| STATS min_ratio = MIN(metrics.sqlserver.page.buffer_cache.hit_ratio),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// Ideally > 95%; drops mean disk reads replacing cache hits
| WHERE min_ratio < 95.0
| KEEP instance_id, min_ratio

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-database-io-lat.name: [SQL Server OTel] Database I/O latency high
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-database-io-lat.esql:
TS metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Per-database file I/O latency (counter); INCREASE over window indicates storage pressure
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.database.latency IS NOT NULL
    AND metrics.sqlserver.database.operations IS NOT NULL
| STATS lat_increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.sqlserver.database.latency)),
       ops_increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.sqlserver.database.operations))
  BY instance_id = COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown"),
     database_name = COALESCE(resource.attributes.sqlserver.database.name, ""),
     file_type = COALESCE(attributes.file_type, file_type, ""),
     direction = COALESCE(attributes.direction, direction, "")
// Avg latency per op > 0.1s (100ms) when we have operations in the window
| WHERE ops_increase > 0 AND (lat_increase / ops_increase) > 0.1
| KEEP instance_id, database_name, file_type, direction, lat_increase, ops_increase

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-deadlocks-detec.name: [SQL Server OTel] Deadlocks detected
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-deadlocks-detec.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Any non-zero sustained deadlock rate is a serious concurrency problem
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.deadlock.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_deadlocks = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.deadlock.rate),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE max_deadlocks > 0
| KEEP instance_id, max_deadlocks

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-execution-error.name: [SQL Server OTel] Execution errors
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-execution-error.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Direct error count from the engine
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.database.execution.errors IS NOT NULL
| STATS total_errors = SUM(metrics.sqlserver.database.execution.errors),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE total_errors > 0
| KEEP instance_id, total_errors

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-free-list-stall.name: [SQL Server OTel] Free list stalls
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-free-list-stall.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Buffer pool cannot find a free page — indicates extreme memory pressure
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.page.buffer_cache.free_list.stalls.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_stalls = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.page.buffer_cache.free_list.stalls.rate),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE max_stalls > 0
| KEEP instance_id, max_stalls

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-lock-timeouts.name: [SQL Server OTel] Lock timeouts
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-lock-timeouts.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Lock timeouts: queries giving up waiting for locks
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.lock.timeout.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_timeouts = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.lock.timeout.rate),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE max_timeouts > 0
| KEEP instance_id, max_timeouts

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-lock-wait-rate-.name: [SQL Server OTel] Lock wait rate high
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-lock-wait-rate-.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Lock requests resulting in waits per second; high values mean queries blocking each other
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.lock.wait.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS avg_wait_rate = AVG(metrics.sqlserver.lock.wait.rate),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// Adjust threshold (requests/s) based on expected workload; 10 is a starting point
| WHERE avg_wait_rate > 10.0
| KEEP instance_id, avg_wait_rate

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-login-rate-spik.name: [SQL Server OTel] Login rate spike
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-login-rate-spik.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// High login rate may indicate connection pool misconfiguration or connection storm
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.login.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS avg_login_rate = AVG(metrics.sqlserver.login.rate),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// Adjust threshold (logins/s) based on baseline; 50/s is a starting point for investigation
| WHERE avg_login_rate > 50.0
| KEEP instance_id, avg_login_rate

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-memory-grants-p.name: [SQL Server OTel] Memory grants pending
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-memory-grants-p.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Queries waiting for memory grants cannot execute; any sustained non-zero is critical
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.memory.grants.pending.count IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_pending = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.memory.grants.pending.count),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
| WHERE max_pending > 0
| KEEP instance_id, max_pending

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-os-wait-duratio.name: [SQL Server OTel] OS wait duration high
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-os-wait-duratio.esql:
TS metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Cumulative wait time by wait type (counter); PAGEIOLATCH_SH, WRITELOG, SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD indicate I/O/CPU pressure
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.os.wait.duration IS NOT NULL
| STATS wait_increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.sqlserver.os.wait.duration))
  BY instance_id = COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown"),
     wait_type = COALESCE(attributes.wait.type, wait.type, "")
// Alert when wait time increased by > 60s in the window (indicates sustained waits)
| WHERE wait_increase > 60.0
| KEEP instance_id, wait_type, wait_increase

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-page-life-expec.name: [SQL Server OTel] Page life expectancy low
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-page-life-expec.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Instance-level metric: buffer pool page lifetime in seconds
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.page.life_expectancy IS NOT NULL
| STATS min_ple = MIN(metrics.sqlserver.page.life_expectancy),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// PLE below 300s indicates severe memory pressure; adjust threshold for your environment
| WHERE min_ple < 300
| KEEP instance_id, min_ple

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-tempdb-space-lo.name: [SQL Server OTel] TempDB space low
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-tempdb-space-lo.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// TempDB space by state (free/used); filter for free space
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.database.tempdb.space IS NOT NULL
| WHERE COALESCE(attributes.tempdb.state, tempdb.state) == "free"
| STATS min_free_kb = MIN(metrics.sqlserver.database.tempdb.space),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// Alert when free space below 100MB (102400 KB); adjust for your TempDB size
| WHERE min_free_kb < 102400
| KEEP instance_id, min_free_kb

microsoft_sqlserver_otel-tempdb-version-.name: [SQL Server OTel] TempDB version store large
microsoft_sqlserver_otel-tempdb-version-.esql:
FROM metrics-sqlserverreceiver.otel-default
// Version store growth can exhaust TempDB; affects snapshot isolation, sorts, spills
| WHERE metrics.sqlserver.database.tempdb.version_store.size IS NOT NULL
| STATS max_version_store_kb = MAX(metrics.sqlserver.database.tempdb.version_store.size),
       instance_id = MAX(resource.attributes.service.instance.id)
  BY COALESCE(resource.attributes.service.instance.id, host.name, "unknown")
// Alert when version store exceeds 1GB (1048576 KB); adjust for your TempDB capacity
| WHERE max_version_store_kb > 1048576
| KEEP instance_id, max_version_store_kb

mongodb_otel-connection-exhaustion.name: [MongoDB OTel] Connection exhaustion
mongodb_otel-connection-exhaustion.esql:
TS metrics-mongodbreceiver.otel-default
// Scope to MongoDB OTel metrics
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "mongodbreceiver.otel"
| WHERE metrics.mongodb.connection.count IS NOT NULL AND attributes.type == "available"
// Minimum available connections per (server, database); then worst per server
| STATS avail = MIN(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.mongodb.connection.count)) BY resource.attributes.server.address, attributes.db.namespace
| STATS min_avail = MIN(avail) BY resource.attributes.server.address
// Alert when available connections drop below threshold (adjust 10 for your pool size)
| WHERE min_avail < 10
| SORT min_avail ASC
| LIMIT 20

mongodb_otel-cursor-timeouts.name: [MongoDB OTel] Cursor timeouts
mongodb_otel-cursor-timeouts.esql:
FROM metrics-mongodbreceiver.otel-default
// Scope to MongoDB OTel metrics
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "mongodbreceiver.otel"
| WHERE metrics.mongodb.cursor.timeout.count IS NOT NULL
// Delta over time window (metric is non-monotonic sum; increase indicates new timeouts)
| STATS min_val = MIN(metrics.mongodb.cursor.timeout.count), max_val = MAX(metrics.mongodb.cursor.timeout.count) BY resource.attributes.server.address
| EVAL new_timeouts = max_val - min_val
// Alert on any new cursor timeouts (clients unable to consume results in time)
| WHERE new_timeouts > 0
| SORT new_timeouts DESC
| LIMIT 20

mongodb_otel-global-lock-contention.name: [MongoDB OTel] Global lock contention

mongodb_otel-high-cache-miss-rate.name: [MongoDB OTel] High cache miss rate
mongodb_otel-high-cache-miss-rate.esql:
TS metrics-mongodbreceiver.otel-default
// Scope to MongoDB OTel metrics
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "mongodbreceiver.otel"
| WHERE metrics.mongodb.cache.operations IS NOT NULL
// Split hit vs miss for cache operations (counter); both branches output same schema
| FORK (
    WHERE attributes.type == "hit"
    | STATS hits = SUM(RATE(metrics.mongodb.cache.operations)) BY resource.attributes.server.address
    | EVAL server = resource.attributes.server.address, misses = 0.0
  )
  (
    WHERE attributes.type == "miss"
    | STATS misses = SUM(RATE(metrics.mongodb.cache.operations)) BY resource.attributes.server.address
    | EVAL server = resource.attributes.server.address, hits = 0.0
  )
| STATS hits = SUM(hits), misses = SUM(misses) BY server
| WHERE hits IS NOT NULL AND misses IS NOT NULL AND (hits + misses) > 0
| EVAL miss_rate = ROUND(misses / (hits + misses) * 100.0, 2)
// Alert when cache miss rate exceeds 5% (working set may exceed WiredTiger cache)
| WHERE miss_rate > 5.0
| SORT miss_rate DESC
| LIMIT 20

mongodb_otel-high-cursor-count.name: [MongoDB OTel] High cursor count

mongodb_otel-high-memory-usage.name: [MongoDB OTel] High memory usage

mongodb_otel-high-operation-latency.name: [MongoDB OTel] High operation latency
mongodb_otel-high-operation-latency.esql:
TS metrics-mongodbreceiver.otel-default
// Scope to MongoDB OTel metrics
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "mongodbreceiver.otel"
| WHERE metrics.mongodb.operation.time IS NOT NULL OR metrics.mongodb.operation.count IS NOT NULL
// operation.time and operation.count are in separate docs; FORK to combine
| FORK (
    WHERE metrics.mongodb.operation.time IS NOT NULL
    | STATS op_time_rate = SUM(RATE(metrics.mongodb.operation.time)) BY resource.attributes.server.address, attributes.operation
    | EVAL server = resource.attributes.server.address, op = attributes.operation, op_count_rate = 0.0
  )
  (
    WHERE metrics.mongodb.operation.count IS NOT NULL
    | STATS op_count_rate = SUM(RATE(metrics.mongodb.operation.count)) BY resource.attributes.server.address, attributes.operation
    | EVAL server = resource.attributes.server.address, op = attributes.operation, op_time_rate = 0.0
  )
| STATS op_time_rate = SUM(op_time_rate), op_count_rate = SUM(op_count_rate) BY server, op
| WHERE op_count_rate > 0
| EVAL avg_latency_ms = ROUND(op_time_rate / op_count_rate, 2)
// Alert when avg latency exceeds 100ms (adjust for your slow query threshold)
| WHERE avg_latency_ms > 100
| SORT avg_latency_ms DESC
| LIMIT 20

mongodb_otel-high-session-count.name: [MongoDB OTel] High session count

mysql_otel-high-buffer-pool-dirty-ratio.name: [MySQL OTel] High buffer pool dirty page ratio
mysql_otel-high-buffer-pool-dirty-ratio.esql:
FROM metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Buffer pool usage (bytes) by status: clean vs dirty; gauges
| WHERE metrics.mysql.buffer_pool.usage IS NOT NULL
    AND attributes.status IN ("dirty", "clean")
| STATS
    dirty = MAX(metrics.mysql.buffer_pool.usage) WHERE attributes.status == "dirty",
    clean = MAX(metrics.mysql.buffer_pool.usage) WHERE attributes.status == "clean"
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint
| EVAL total = dirty + clean, ratio = CASE(total > 0, dirty / total, 0)
// Alert when dirty ratio > 75%; InnoDB will flush aggressively above this
| WHERE ratio > 0.75 AND total > 0
| SORT ratio DESC

mysql_otel-high-connection-error-rate.name: [MySQL OTel] High connection error rate
mysql_otel-high-connection-error-rate.esql:
TS metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Connection errors are a monotonic counter; use INCREASE for delta over the time window
| WHERE metrics.mysql.connection.errors IS NOT NULL
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.mysql.connection.errors))
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint, attributes.error
// Alert when more than 5 connection errors in the window; adjust threshold as needed
| WHERE increase > 5
| SORT increase DESC

mysql_otel-high-row-lock-contention.name: [MySQL OTel] High row lock contention
mysql_otel-high-row-lock-contention.esql:
TS metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Row lock waits are a monotonic counter; use INCREASE for delta over the time window
| WHERE metrics.mysql.row_locks IS NOT NULL
    AND attributes.kind == "waits"
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.mysql.row_locks))
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint
// Alert when more than 100 lock waits in the window; tune based on workload
| WHERE increase > 100
| SORT increase DESC

mysql_otel-high-slow-query-rate.name: [MySQL OTel] High slow query rate
mysql_otel-high-slow-query-rate.esql:
TS metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Slow query count is a monotonic counter; use INCREASE for delta over the time window
| WHERE metrics.mysql.query.slow.count IS NOT NULL
| STATS increase = SUM(INCREASE(metrics.mysql.query.slow.count))
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint
// Alert when more than 10 slow queries in the window; tune based on long_query_time and traffic
| WHERE increase > 10
| SORT increase DESC

mysql_otel-replication-lag.name: [MySQL OTel] Replication lag
mysql_otel-replication-lag.esql:
FROM metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Replica lag is a gauge (seconds behind source); only present on replica instances
| WHERE metrics.mysql.replica.time_behind_source IS NOT NULL
| STATS lag_seconds = MAX(metrics.mysql.replica.time_behind_source)
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint
// Alert when lag exceeds 60 seconds; adjust for your RPO requirements
| WHERE lag_seconds > 60
| SORT lag_seconds DESC

mysql_otel-thread-saturation.name: [MySQL OTel] Thread saturation
mysql_otel-thread-saturation.esql:
FROM metrics-mysqlreceiver.otel-*
// Threads are gauges; pivot running vs connected by instance
| WHERE metrics.mysql.threads IS NOT NULL
    AND attributes.kind IN ("running", "connected")
| STATS
    running = MAX(metrics.mysql.threads) WHERE attributes.kind == "running",
    connected = MAX(metrics.mysql.threads) WHERE attributes.kind == "connected"
  BY resource.attributes.mysql.instance.endpoint
// Saturation = running threads close to connected (CPU-bound workload)
| EVAL ratio = CASE(connected > 0, running / connected, 0)
// Alert when ratio > 0.9 and we have meaningful thread count; adjust threshold as needed
| WHERE ratio > 0.9 AND connected >= 5
| SORT ratio DESC

nvidia_gpu_otel-clock-frequency-throttle.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] Clock frequency throttled under load
nvidia_gpu_otel-clock-frequency-throttle.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK IS NOT NULL
    AND DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL IS NOT NULL
    AND DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    avg_sm_clock = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK),
    max_sm_clock = MAX(DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK),
    avg_util = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL),
    avg_temp = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName
// Detect throttling: GPU is under load (>50% util) but clock is low
// relative to its observed max — indicates thermal or power throttling
// Adjust the clock ratio threshold based on your GPU model's expected boost clocks
| WHERE avg_util > 50 AND max_sm_clock > 0
| EVAL clock_ratio = ROUND(avg_sm_clock / max_sm_clock * 100.0, 2)
| WHERE clock_ratio < 70
| SORT clock_ratio ASC

nvidia_gpu_otel-framebuffer-memory-high.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] Framebuffer memory utilization high
nvidia_gpu_otel-framebuffer-memory-high.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED IS NOT NULL AND DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE IS NOT NULL
| EVAL total_fb = DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE
| EVAL fb_used_pct = ROUND(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED / total_fb * 100.0, 2)
// Alert when framebuffer usage exceeds 90%
// Adjust threshold based on workload — ML training may routinely use 85-95%
| WHERE fb_used_pct > 90
| STATS
    max_used_pct = MAX(fb_used_pct),
    avg_used_pct = AVG(fb_used_pct),
    min_free_mb = MIN(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName
| SORT max_used_pct DESC

nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-idle-during-expected.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] GPU idle during expected workload
nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-idle-during-expected.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    avg_util = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL),
    max_util = MAX(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName
// Detects GPUs that are completely idle — may indicate a stuck job,
// misconfigured workload, or wasted resources
// Adjust threshold and alertDelay based on expected idle periods
| WHERE max_util < 1
| SORT Hostname ASC

nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-temperature-critical.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] GPU temperature critical
nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-temperature-critical.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP IS NOT NULL
// Threshold in Celsius — adjust based on your GPU model and data center cooling
// Most data center GPUs throttle at 83-90°C
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP > 83
| STATS
    max_temp = MAX(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP),
    avg_temp = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName
| SORT max_temp DESC

nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-utilization-saturate.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] GPU utilization saturated
nvidia_gpu_otel-gpu-utilization-saturate.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    avg_util = AVG(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL),
    max_util = MAX(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName
// Sustained high utilization above 95% indicates compute saturation
// Adjust threshold based on workload expectations
| WHERE avg_util > 95
| SORT avg_util DESC

nvidia_gpu_otel-xid-errors-detected.name: [NVIDIA GPU OTel] XID errors detected
nvidia_gpu_otel-xid-errors-detected.esql:
FROM metrics-nvidia_gpu.otel-default
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS IS NOT NULL
// Non-zero XID errors indicate GPU hardware or software faults
// err_code identifies the specific XID error type
| WHERE DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS > 0
| STATS
    max_xid = MAX(DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS),
    occurrences = COUNT(*)
  BY Hostname, UUID, modelName, err_code, err_msg
| SORT occurrences DESC

oracle_otel-buffer-cache-hit-ratio-low.name: [Oracle OTel] Buffer cache hit ratio low
oracle_otel-buffer-cache-hit-ratio-low.esql:
TS metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// logical_reads and physical_reads are co-located in Reads TSDB group; INCREASE for counter deltas
| WHERE oracledb.logical_reads IS NOT NULL
        AND oracledb.physical_reads IS NOT NULL
| STATS delta_physical = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.physical_reads)),
        delta_logical = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.logical_reads))
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name
| WHERE delta_logical > 0
// Hit ratio = 1 - (physical / logical); < 90% indicates buffer cache thrashing
// Adjust threshold (e.g. 0.95 for 95%) to tune sensitivity
| EVAL hit_ratio_pct = ROUND((1.0 - delta_physical / delta_logical) * 100.0, 1)
| WHERE hit_ratio_pct < 90
| SORT hit_ratio_pct ASC

oracle_otel-dml-lock-utilisation-high.name: [Oracle OTel] DML lock utilisation high

oracle_otel-enqueue-deadlocks-detected.name: [Oracle OTel] Enqueue deadlocks detected

oracle_otel-enqueue-lock-utilisation-hig.name: [Oracle OTel] Enqueue lock utilisation high
oracle_otel-enqueue-lock-utilisation-hig.esql:
FROM metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// Enqueue locks usage and limit are in separate TSDB document groups; aggregate across time window
| STATS usage = MAX(oracledb.enqueue_locks.usage),
        limit_val = MAX(oracledb.enqueue_locks.limit)
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name
| WHERE limit_val > 0
// Utilisation > 85% precedes lock contention and enqueue wait events
// Adjust threshold to tune sensitivity
| EVAL utilisation_pct = ROUND(usage * 100.0 / limit_val, 1)
| WHERE utilisation_pct > 85
| SORT utilisation_pct DESC

oracle_otel-hard-parse-ratio-high.name: [Oracle OTel] Hard parse ratio high
oracle_otel-hard-parse-ratio-high.esql:
TS metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// hard_parses and parse_calls are co-located in Parses TSDB group; INCREASE for counter deltas
| WHERE oracledb.parse_calls IS NOT NULL
        AND oracledb.hard_parses IS NOT NULL
| STATS delta_hard = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.hard_parses)),
        delta_total = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.parse_calls))
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name
| WHERE delta_total > 0
// Ratio > 10% indicates shared pool pressure, ad-hoc SQL, or missing bind variables
// Adjust threshold (e.g. 0.05 for 5%) for stricter monitoring
| EVAL hard_parse_ratio_pct = ROUND(delta_hard / delta_total * 100.0, 1)
| WHERE hard_parse_ratio_pct > 10
| SORT hard_parse_ratio_pct DESC

oracle_otel-process-utilisation-high.name: [Oracle OTel] Process utilisation high
oracle_otel-process-utilisation-high.esql:
FROM metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// Process usage and limit are in separate TSDB document groups; aggregate across time window
| STATS usage = MAX(oracledb.processes.usage),
        limit_val = MAX(oracledb.processes.limit)
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name
| WHERE limit_val > 0
// Utilisation threshold: 85% — approaching process limit causes ORA-00020 connection refusals
// Adjust threshold to tune sensitivity (e.g. 80 for earlier warning)
| EVAL utilisation_pct = ROUND(usage * 100.0 / limit_val, 1)
| WHERE utilisation_pct > 85
| SORT utilisation_pct DESC

oracle_otel-rollback-to-commit-ratio-hig.name: [Oracle OTel] Rollback-to-commit ratio high
oracle_otel-rollback-to-commit-ratio-hig.esql:
TS metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// user_commits and user_rollbacks are in separate TSDB groups; INCREASE for counter deltas
| STATS delta_commits = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.user_commits)),
        delta_rollbacks = SUM(INCREASE(oracledb.user_rollbacks))
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name
| EVAL total_tx = delta_commits + delta_rollbacks
| WHERE total_tx > 0
// Ratio > 10% signals systematic transaction failures (constraint violations, timeouts)
// Adjust threshold (e.g. 0.05 for 5%) to tune sensitivity
| EVAL rollback_ratio_pct = ROUND(delta_rollbacks / total_tx * 100.0, 1)
| WHERE rollback_ratio_pct > 10
| SORT rollback_ratio_pct DESC

oracle_otel-session-utilisation-high.name: [Oracle OTel] Session utilisation high

oracle_otel-tablespace-utilisation-high.name: [Oracle OTel] Tablespace utilisation high
oracle_otel-tablespace-utilisation-high.esql:
FROM metrics-oracledbreceiver.otel-*
// Tablespace metrics are dimensioned by attributes.tablespace_name
| WHERE oracledb.tablespace_size.usage IS NOT NULL
        AND oracledb.tablespace_size.limit IS NOT NULL
| STATS usage = MAX(oracledb.tablespace_size.usage),
        limit_val = MAX(oracledb.tablespace_size.limit)
        BY oracledb.instance.name, host.name, attributes.tablespace_name
// Exclude unlimited tablespaces (limit -1)
| WHERE limit_val > 0
// Utilisation threshold: 90% — critical for SYSTEM/SYSAUX; write failures at full
// Adjust threshold per environment (e.g. 85 for stricter monitoring)
| EVAL utilisation_pct = ROUND(usage * 100.0 / limit_val, 1)
| WHERE utilisation_pct > 90
| SORT utilisation_pct DESC

oracle_otel-transaction-limit-utilisatio.name: [Oracle OTel] Transaction limit utilisation high

otel-collector-internal-telemetry-otel-e.name: [OpenTelemetry Collector Internal Telemetry Otel] Exporter send failed log records
[OpenTelemetry Collector Internal Telemetry Otel] Exporter send failed metric points
